agency: Alabama Dept. of Conservation & Natural Resources
harvest_notes: Plants must be at least 5 years old with 3 compound leaves. Count stem scars on the root neck to confirm: a 5-year-old plant carries 4 scars. source: U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service, American Ginseng export program

state_name: Menominee Indian Tribe Reservation of Wisconsin
harvest_notes: The Menominee Reservation is the one tribal jurisdiction approved by FWS for wild American ginseng harvest and trade. Harvest is governed by tribal law, not Wisconsin state law. Permission from the Tribe is required; non-members should assume harvest is not open to them.
source: U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service, American Ginseng export program
